claims.feature: Encodes reserved and non-ASCII characters as UTF-8 percent codes
tests: ui:url-encoder:percent-encoding table agrees with Raw mode for every character it lists

claims.feature: Keeps a URL's structure and encodes only the query values
tests: ui:url-encoder:smart mode keeps URL structure, encodes query values
